subject: Re: Kickoff: unsupervised depth + motion for AR occlusion
body:
Status: training reproduced, four days late but done. With ImageNet init (init_ckpt_type=imagenet) and Giannis's Struct2depth-format conversion, depth error on our driving held-out set is within 6% relative of the reference implementation.

The interesting risk is the motion field. Because the model predicts a full 3D translation field for every pixel, it will happily explain away moving objects as depth errors in scenes with lots of dynamics -- our urban clips are exactly that. The learned-intrinsics path also converges slower than specified intrinsics, roughly 1.4x steps to the same error.

Mitigation I want to try: stronger motion-field regularization for the first 20k steps. Leilani's harness is what will tell us if it actually helps -- her depth-metric suite is running, motion metrics land next week.

Katya
